root_cause: LinkedIn dispatch is Composio-only, but the supervisor still executed a legacy Buffer sync without containment, so a Buffer network/provider failure could abort the broader content loop.
The content orchestrator collapsed every non-2xx Anthropic response into AI_PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED, hiding the HTTP status and model needed for autonomous diagnosis.
On 2026-09-25 the artifact-ai stage failed repeatedly, leaving both LinkedIn decisions at decided with no content artifacts.
prevention: LinkedIn personal and company publication authority remains Composio-only with exact provider URN readback and no Buffer fallback.
Legacy Buffer sync is compatibility telemetry only, is explicitly non-blocking, and records degraded state instead of failing the LinkedIn loop.
AI provider failures retain only sanitized HTTP status and model identity; provider payloads and secrets are never logged.
The content AI call has a bounded 45-second timeout so a hung provider cannot stall a scheduler run.

For provider HTTP 400 validation failures, retain only sanitized provider error type/message so request-shape defects can be repaired deterministically without logging prompts, source data, or credentials.

evidence.production_observation: 84 powerhouse-content-orchestrator health rows on 2026-09-25 reported artifact-ai:AI_PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED before remediation.
evidence.linkedin_transport: powerhouse-social-publisher has dedicated Composio branches for linkedin_personal and linkedin_company, exact LINKEDIN_GET_POST_CONTENT readback, buffer_dependency:false and republish_forbidden fail-closed handling.
evidence.anthropic_400: Post-deploy production readback on 2026-09-25 proved HTTP 400 for claude-sonnet-4-6; the diagnostic now retains only provider error type/message capped at 240 characters, never request payloads or credentials.
